entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I'm calling about an order I received last month. I'd like to start a return for a helmet I purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a matter of preference. The color just wasn't what I was expecting from the photos online. The box is still unopened, so all the safety seals are perfectly intact.
I understand completely. Getting the right color is important. Let me just pull up your order details and review our return policy. I see the order was delivered 33 days ago.

Okay, I've checked the policy for you. Our standard return window for an item like this helmet is 90 days. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund.
That's great news, thank you. I appreciate you making that so straightforward.
Of course. I've just emailed a prepaid shipping label to you. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office.

Perfect. One last question. Since I do plan to buy another helmet in a different color from you, and I am going through the trouble of shipping this one back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase?

I'm happy to hear you're sticking with us for your gear. While I'm not able to offer a discount code for a preference-based return, your full refund will be processed as soon as we receive the item. You can then use that to purchase the new helmet you want.
Alright, that's fair. I thought it was worth asking. Thank you for your help with the return label.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a wonderful day.
